title: Microsoft Exchange Server Exchange Control Panel Fixed Cryptographic Key Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Exchange Server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Exchange Control Panel web application. The product fails to generate a unique cryptographic key at installation, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
